# Synthetic spec-kit fixture

The spec, plan and tasks templates in [`.specify/templates/`](.specify/templates/)
are byte-for-byte copies from the local source
[`tests/fixtures/speckit-upstream/v1.3.2/templates/`](../speckit-upstream/v1.3.2/templates/).
They come from github/spec-kit release tag `v1.3.2`, commit
`55264c2f2f2d1146f02abc543cb913dcdf1f9342`; see the
[pinned source attribution](../speckit-upstream/v1.3.2/README.md).
All upstream placeholders are retained, and no network access is needed.

The accompanying [MIT LICENSE](LICENSE), Copyright GitHub, Inc., is copied
byte-for-byte from the [local upstream license](../speckit-upstream/v1.3.2/LICENSE).

The [constitution](.specify/memory/constitution.md) is synthetic test content
authored for this fixture, separate from the unmodified upstream templates.
